display_name: 原E200：跨TX/day频谱变化的有限IQ操作与身份梯度诊断
description: 验证L交叉拟合的共同RX频谱变化能否转成有限IQ操作，并量化对成熟身份网络的影响，不用V/target选择
authorization: 持续目标授权下源域机制研究；承接已完成RX频谱交叉拟合证据，回答新增目标通过什么更新成熟骨干

code.commit: resolved from immutable Git release at launch

data.representation: equalized=1; center crop/pad 256; per-packet complex RMS; center=False; fs=25MHz

roles.U_use: IQ/RX/day/opaque UID;15domain round-robin, within-domain private permutation before reuse; no TX grouping or same-sig cross-RX pairing

data.split_id: inherited deterministic physical source roles (historical protocol label 392005)
data.train_ratio_definition: rho_label=L_s/(L_s+U_s)=0.1 unchanged; U_s TX truth never visible
data.diagnostic_access: Only L IQ/TX/RX/day/opaque IDs consumed; legacy source cache V/old features deserialized but not used. No U opened. No target.

permissions.claim_scope: source L IQ action/identity/gradient diagnosis; not unknown-RX accuracy

checkpoint.initialization: corresponding original E200, frozen; no optimizer/EMA/E40/compressed parent

execution.gpu_policy: <=3 total GPU processes including other owners; >=12000MB free; all8GPU pool
execution.stop_rule: technical failure stops pending; healthy rows finish; no automatic retry/overwrite

metric_names: L accuracy and paired fixes/breaks byTX
actual observable and FIR response error
dense encoder/head gradient norm and direction
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: source L labels only; no target scorer

averaging.buffers: fixed final buffers; BatchNorm architecture forbidden

action.fit: fresh original E200, same-scale tanh coordinates, abs noise, first full pass raw margin then full pass finite risk

evaluation.control_role: full 2x4 fixed factorial, matched original E200 parents; no epoch-selected parent

semi.teacher_init: after update888: cloned EMA or live stop-gradient student according to target_provider
semi.statistics_mask: separate physical quality, all soft assignments

parent_build_config.optimization_scope: all native identity encoder/fusion/classifier parameters; no frozen identity layers; domain networks frozen

physical.action_targets: four actual applied tap components / scale
physical.repetition_target: leave-cycle relative template residual24 + learned diagonal uncertainty
physical.known_linear_scope: small circular digital filter; interior-only diagnostic required

parent_build_config.mechanism_scope: No new auxiliary losses in this causal control batch; no EMA branch creates no averaged copy. Inherited old reference only in O rows, original gates unchanged throughout.

intervention.crossfit: other five TX AND other two days

intervention.gradient_sample: first packet of every L TX/day/RX cell; 90 balanced packets
intervention.gradient_scope: dense encoder/fusion-head only; excludes frequency coordinates with different units; norms and cosine, not optimizer steps
